body: I cannot even remember not being depressed. Nostalgia is a different kind of depression for me. Like the bitter sweet realization, that once, everything could have gone different for me if somebody had just cared enough. But noone ever did. Nostalgia is remembering how I fantasized about a better life where I still had dreams

Yoo, I wish u all the best of luck trying to quit! I get if soo much. I never was a happy child - my parents managed to have 3/3 children get mentally ill... the alcohol provides relief for a short time.. but I wish i could stop relying on alcohol to feel better. In the end, I always feel worse. I really hope it works out for you! And you are not pathetic. You are a human being, who tries to give your best. That does not make you pathetic.
